description: Use for "what is Bitcoin doing and why", first: one morning briefing from BTC Intel's published Brief and Full Read. It gives the price now with its 24-hour, 3-day and 12-month moves and the distance from the cycle high; the market read in one sentence; the five areas (Technical, On-chain, Market structure, Sentiment, Macro) with each one's reason and last change; the forces moving the market, each with the figures behind it (for example stablecoin supply, funding, ETF flows, VIX); what changed today, this week and this month; what would change the read; and the events coming up. detail "full" adds the full reasoning and 14 days of calendar instead of 7. For the calendar alone use get_calendar, for one area in depth get_area, for the BTC Intel Score get_score_for_day. The Brief is published at 6 AM ET; the price is rolling. Free.

detail.description: summary (default): the briefing, about a page of text. full: adds the reasoning and two weeks of events.

name: get_bitcoin_today
title: Bitcoin today: price, the read and why
